Existing Highway Facilities
General Mitchell Field lies in the southeastern part of Milwaukee County and is located 6-1/2 miles directly south of downtown Milwaukee. The airport is bounded by surface arterials of Layton and College Avenues on the north and south respectively, and Howell Avenue on the west. See figure 4. The Chicago Northwestern Railroad is the eastern limits of the airport.
The main entrance to the airport terminal facilities is from Howell Avenue-State Trunk Highway (STH) 38, and is located approximately 3/4 miles south of Layton Avenue-County Trunk Highway (CTH) Y.
All existing access to and from the airport from !!ilwaukee County's existing freeway system involves travel over howell Avenue, in combination with either Layton Avenue, South 27th Street, Howard Avenue or College Avenue. See figure 4.
The approximate time of travel from the existing Interstate freeway access ramps to General Mitchell Field is as follows:
1. From the north, exit I-94 at Howard Avenue ramps, travel east to Howell Avenue and south to Airport. (2.1 miles of travel with 5.5 minute travel time).
2. From the north, exit I-94 at Layton Avenue ramps, travel east on Layton to Howell and south to airport. (2.1 miles of travel with 4.5 minute travel time).*
3. From the west, exit I-894 at 27th Street, travel south to Layton Avenue, east to Howell Avenue, and south to Airport. (2.9 miles to travel with 5.8 minute travel time).
4. From the south, exit I-94 at College Avenue, travel east on College Avenue to Howell, and north on Howell to the Airport. (2.4 miles of travel with 5.1 minute travel time).
* Additional travel between Howard Avenue and Layton Avenue via I-94 is 1.7 miles with 2.0 minute time at 50 mph.
